title: Your ViT is Secretly an Image Segmentation Model (EoMT)
mechanism: Plain ViT with learnable queries injected for the last blocks predicts class + mask directly; mask annealing removes masked attention at inference, so no adapter or pixel decoder.
evidence: R: COCO PQ gap to ViT-Adapter+M2F shrinks with scale and pretraining (-5.8 ViT-S, -3.8 B, -1.1 L, -0.7 g; -6.1 with IN1K pretraining); ADE20K 58.4 mIoU at 512 with ViT-L DINOv2; small-object AP drops most (23.4 to 20.3); up to 4x faster. DINOv3 EoMT-L 59.5 ADE20K per README.
adaptation: ViT-L/16 DINOv2-reg (DINOv3 if user OKs gated weights) from ADE20K semantic ckpt with class head reset; grey replicated to 3 ch; 1024 px input so tokens cover 32 px of original; add a 2-layer full-res conv refinement head on upsampled mask logits + raw image for 1-2 px cracks; dense CE + Dice on crack/inactive on the final semantic map; layer-wise lr decay (PF-like); ~50 queries for 24 classes; also used as a heterogeneous-ensemble member with the house 5-seed ensemble.
min_experiment: Arm EoMT-L 1024 + refinement + dense aux, 20k steps, module-grouped 5-fold CV then 5 seeds on test/E1; baseline house PF; metrics inactive IoU, mIoU_rob, E1 crack relF1@2, E1 inactive IoU, plus ensemble arm (softmax average with house ensemble, weight from val). Kill alone if inactive IoU < 0.449 and mIoU_rob < 0.570 and E1 relF1@2 < 0.43; kill as ensemble member if no metric beats the paired noise floor (crack IoU 0.012).
prior_overlap: Foundation encoders row: frozen ViT-S/ConvNeXt-T probes and one ConvNeXt-T 4k-step screen. ViT-L, mask decoders, 1024 input and long schedules are explicitly listed as not closed. Open.

alt_notes.adaptation: Benchmark baseline for modern ViT mask classification; run at 1024 for 64 x 64 tokens; expect crack weakness, possible gains on inactive, material and other blob classes.
alt_notes.min_experiment: EoMT DINOv2-L @1024, 3 seeds; mIoU_rob and inactive IoU vs house; kill if mIoU_rob < 0.57 and inactive < 0.44.

alt_notes.adaptation: ViT-L DINOv2-reg (DINOv3 if user OKs gated weights) from ADE20K semantic checkpoint without class head; grey replicated to 3 ch; 1024 px input; full-res path (LoftUp-style upsampler or conv head on upsampled mask logits + raw EL image); dense CE + Dice on crack/inactive on final semantic map; layer-wise lr decay 0.8 as PF analogue; 24 classes, 2 queries per class.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm EoMT-L DINOv2 1024 px + full-res head + dense aux, 20k steps vs house PF on module-grouped 5-fold CV then 5 seeds; metrics inactive IoU, mIoU_rob, E1 crack relF1@2, E1 inactive IoU; kill if inactive IoU < 0.449 and mIoU_rob < 0.570 and E1 relF1@2 < 0.43; also test as ensemble member with house 5-seed ensemble, kill if no metric beats noise floor (crack IoU 0.012).
